primary_estimand.name: selection-oriented held-out within-molecule WSD
primary_estimand.selection_rule: argmax coordinate on selection molecules only
primary_estimand.evaluation_score: selection orientation times mean signed WSD at the same coordinate
primary_estimand.null: whole pipeline; labels shuffled within molecule preserving coverage

within_type_estimand.name: selection-oriented held-out within-token-type WSD
within_type_estimand.formula: sum_i c_i*x_i / (sigma_all*sqrt(n*sum_i c_i^2)), c_i = y_i - n_in,T(i)/n_T(i)
within_type_estimand.interpretation: semipartial correlation of the coordinate with fragment membership after removing token-type means from the label; with one token type in the molecule it equals the primary WSD
within_type_estimand.token_type: current-token identity, the code atom_type_onehot encodes
within_type_estimand.combination_rule: per-type in-minus-out mean differences pooled with the Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel weight n_in,T*n_out,T/n_T; coverage factor sqrt(sum_T n_in,T*n_out,T/n_T / n) replaces sqrt(p*(1-p)); sigma_all is the primary estimand's whole-molecule SD
within_type_estimand.eligible_molecules: molecules with at least one token type present both inside and outside the match; equal weight
within_type_estimand.fragment_eligibility: eligible molecules >= min_molecules_per_half in both halves; others listed in skipped_fragments_within_type
within_type_estimand.selection_rule: argmax coordinate on selection molecules only
within_type_estimand.evaluation_score: selection orientation times mean signed within-type WSD at the same coordinate
within_type_estimand.null: whole pipeline; type-matched resample (pipeline_null_type_matched), requires the type_matched null family
within_type_estimand.atom_type_onehot: exactly zero by construction: every one-hot column is constant within token type; its detector is flagged selection_signal_identically_zero

secondary_estimand.name: fixed-coordinate held-out mean absolute within-molecule WSD
secondary_estimand.selection_rule: argmax coordinate on selection molecules only
secondary_estimand.evaluation_score: mean absolute WSD at the same coordinate

distinction_from_schema_v1: v1 pools atom tokens across molecules and can measure molecule-level fragment context; v2 conditions contrasts within matched molecules

atom_type_onehot.note: contains no model activations; upper-bounds what a pure atom-type detector scores on this screen

random_relu_topk32_8192.directions: Gaussian columns normalized to unit L2 norm
